title: Alternate Calendar plugin for standalone Calendar widget, as in the Digital Clock widget
line: The Calendar widget can now show an alternate calendar, holidays and astronomical events, just like the Digital Clock.
explanation: The standalone Calendar widget used the shared MonthView but never gave it an EventPluginsManager, and its settings had no add-ons list, so the calendar plugins (Alternate Calendar, Holidays, Astronomical Events) were only available in the Digital Clock. The change adds the enabledCalendarPlugins setting, the same Available Add-Ons list and per-add-on settings pages as the Digital Clock, and passes the plugins to the month view, which also shows the selected day's alternate date under the month name. MonthView now keeps the header's alternate date bound to today's instead of copying it once, since at widget startup it was copied before the plugin had loaded and stayed empty.

commits.message:
applets/calendar: support calendar add-ons like the Digital Clock

The standalone Calendar widget had no way to show an alternate calendar,
holidays or astronomical events. It now has the same add-ons list and
pages as the Digital Clock, and shows the selected day's alternate date.

BUG: 472750
